brief:
Al Jazeera English marked the deaths of journalists including Anas Akleh and Mohammed El-Lazzo, who were killed while covering the conflict in Gaza, according to the outlet. The journalists faced extraordinary risks to document the war, operating under conditions that have exacted a severe toll on the profession in the territory.

Gaza's media workers have continued reporting despite mounting casualties within their ranks. Al Jazeera noted that its colleagues in Gaza have advanced journalism standards under extreme circumstances, documenting events that might otherwise go unrecorded. The outlet acknowledged that many journalists have paid with their lives for their commitment to covering the conflict and bearing witness to developments on the ground.
dek: Our colleagues in Gaza have taken the journalism profession to an unseen level. In doing so, they've paid a heavy price.
title: Gaza's journalists killed while reporting on the war
